user.title: Modular Screensaver
user.description: Sets up the screensaver. Configure all content afterwards via “Configure”.

abort.already_configured: Modular Screensaver is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Modular Screensaver is already set up.

data_description.users: Empty = all users. Tip: create a dedicated user for the wall tablet and select only that one.
data_description.paths: Comma-separated URL prefixes, e.g. /dashboard-home, /wall-tablet. Empty = all dashboards (settings pages are always excluded).

data_description.entities: Shown as tiles with icon, name and value.
data_description.alert_entities: E.g. windows, doors, smoke detectors. Only shown when on/open/triggered or > 0.

data_description.background_image: Only for background “Image”. E.g. /local/screensaver.jpg (file in /config/www) or an https URL.
data_description.soft_dim: For devices without controllable display brightness.

data_description.display_entity: Optional. Empty = brightness is not controlled.
data_description.night_action: What happens at night when the screensaver starts.

show.name: Show screensaver
show.description: Shows the screensaver immediately on all matching devices.

hide.name: Hide screensaver
hide.description: Hides the screensaver on all devices (e.g. when the doorbell rings).
